# Results — Study 743 (Lucky-Number-8)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test — the
Chinese "lucky 8" (八 *ba* ≈ 發 *fa*, "prosper") superstition should (a) make equity
prices **cluster** on 8-ending values and avoid 4, and (b) give Chinese stocks a
**feel-good bump** around the doubly-auspicious 8/8 calendar date. Offline &
deterministic once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every number.
As-of **2026-06-30** (last complete calendar month). Fingerprint `d880312d91f3` (the
FXI/EEM event panel).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily bars, `auto_adjust=False` → **raw Close** (trailing-digit test) + **Adj Close** (total-return event returns). FXI/EEM event panel: 5,465 rows, 2004-10-08 → 2026-06-30 |
| Event calendar | **hardcoded**: the 8th of August (8/8), one event per year 2005→2025 — the single most auspicious date in Chinese numerology (2008-08-08 8:08 pm = Beijing Olympics opening). All 21 have FXI+EEM coverage |
| Clustering baskets | 15 US-listed **China ADRs** (BABA, JD, PDD, BIDU, NTES, TCOM, NIO, LI, XPEV, BILI, TME, VIPS, YUMC, ZTO, HTHT) vs 15 US-domestic **controls** (AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META, NVDA, JPM, KO, DIS, INTC, CSCO, PFE, WMT, HD, XOM) — both $0.01-tick, so round-number structure is common and cancels |
| Statistics | one-sample *t* across independent, non-overlapping yearly events (the correct unit — not a daily panel); Wilson hit-rate; 20-seed × 200-draw random-window placebo; leave-one-out jackknife; two-proportion *z* on the China−control digit contrast; pooled χ²-vs-uniform |
| Execution / costs | 8/8 is **calendar-known → zero look-ahead** (you always knew the date). One convention: day(-1) = last session before Aug 8, day(0) = first session on/after. Signal = day(-1)→day(-1)+k; Tradability = same window net of 2× one-way cost × NAV |
| Adjustment | trailing-digit test on **raw** Close (a split/dividend-adjusted close has a meaningless last digit); event returns on **Adj Close** (total-return) |

## PART A — the 8/8 superstition premium (event study, FXI − EEM)

Abnormal return of the China large-cap ETF `FXI` minus the emerging-markets benchmark
`EEM`, day(-1) [pre-8/8 close] → day(-1)+k, across the 21 independent years.

| cut | n | mean AR | *t* | hit rate (Wilson 95%) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **the lucky DAY (k=1)** | 21 | **+0.387%** | **+2.27** | 13/21 = 61.9% [40.9%, 79.2%] |
| the lucky WEEK (k=5) | 21 | +0.295% | +0.69 | 12/21 = 57.1% [36.5%, 75.5%] |

The one-day cut nominally clears the desk's *t* ≥ 2 bar; the week does not. Extending the
window from a day to a week roughly holds the mean (+0.30%) but the cross-year variance —
August is a risk-off month for China (2011 sell-off, the 2015-08-11 RMB devaluation, the
2022 slump) — swamps the *t*.

### Random-window placebo (20 seeds × 200 draws per event, right-tail)

| cut | observed | placebo mean (sd) | *p* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| **lucky day** | **+0.387%** | −0.005% (0.224%) | **0.043** |
| lucky week | +0.295% | −0.030% (0.478%) | 0.242 |

The lucky-day mean sits at the tail of the null of random FXI−EEM windows (*p* = 0.043) —
this is a genuine nominal hit, not a naive-*t* artefact. It is also the *only* one of the
two horizons that clears either bar.

### Robustness — leave-one-out jackknife on the lucky-day cut

Full-sample *t* = **+2.273**; jackknife range **[+1.956, +2.806]**, and **4 of 21**
single-year removals push it **below** the *t* = 2 bar. The most load-bearing years are
the ones the folklore would crow about: dropping **2008** (the 08/08/08 triple-8 Olympics
opening, +2.26% that day) takes *t* to **1.96**; dropping 2021, 2009 or 2011 each take it
to ≈ 1.96–1.99. A certification that the single most "lucky" date in the sample is
propping up is exactly the desk's definition of **fragile**.

### The triple-8 callout

2008-08-08 (Beijing Olympics opening, chosen for the 8s): FXI−EEM **lucky-day AR
= +2.26%** — the single best day in the sample — but the surrounding **lucky-week AR
= −3.69%** (the pre-GFC China unwind was already underway). The most auspicious date on
the whole calendar gave one green day inside a red week.

### Event anatomy — mean cumulative AR around 8/8 (anchored at day(-1) = 0)

| offset | −5 | −1 | 0 | +1 | +2 | +5 |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| CAR | +0.32% | 0.00% | +0.387% | +0.34% | +0.35% | +0.48% |

A single-session pop of +0.39% on/around 8/8 that then roughly holds — no run-up, no
give-back. A real, tiny, one-day China-specific tick; nothing that compounds.

### Tradability — the same calendar-known window, net of costs

| cut | gross | net @ 5 bps (*t*) | net @ 10 bps (*t*) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| lucky day | +0.387% (*t* = +2.27) | **+0.287% (+1.69)** | +0.187% (+1.10) |
| lucky week | +0.295% (*t* = +0.69) | +0.195% (+0.46) | +0.095% (+0.22) |

Because 8/8 is calendar-known the window *is* the trade — but the edge is only ~39 bps a
year gross, and one round trip at a realistic 5 bps/side drops it to +0.287% (*t* = 1.69),
below the bar; at 10 bps it is +0.187% (*t* = 1.10). **No cut clears *t* ≥ 2 net of
costs.** Tradability = Mirage.

### Synthetic positive control A (event study) — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic paired (asset, benchmark) log-return world (ρ ≈ 0.85), planted-bump knob.

| world | one-sample *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (bump = 0), **20 seeds** | mean **−0.13** (sd 1.52), \|t\| ≥ 2 in 2/20 |
| planted bump = +1.0% | **+2.49** |
| planted bump = +2.0% | **+6.62** |

Recovers a planted bump, mostly quiet on the null (2/20, the expected false-positive rate
at n = 21). *(A machinery/power check only — never cited in support of the real-tape
stamp.)*

## PART B — trailing-digit clustering (raw closes, China ADRs vs US controls)

Pooled trailing cent digit (`round(px·100) % 10`) of every raw daily close. China ADRs:
**45,997** closes; US control: **82,602** closes.

| digit | China % | control % | diff (pp) | two-prop *z* | *p* |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 0 | **12.286** | 11.014 | **+1.271** | **+6.86** | **0.000** |
| 1 | 9.655 | 9.948 | −0.293 | −1.69 | 0.091 |
| 2 | 9.531 | 9.771 | −0.240 | −1.39 | 0.163 |
| 3 | 9.546 | 9.828 | −0.282 | −1.63 | 0.102 |
| **4** (unlucky) | 9.703 | 9.669 | +0.034 | +0.20 | 0.845 |
| 5 | 10.331 | 10.208 | +0.123 | +0.70 | 0.485 |
| 6 | 9.627 | 9.907 | −0.280 | −1.62 | 0.106 |
| 7 | 9.640 | 9.921 | −0.281 | −1.62 | 0.104 |
| **8** (lucky) | 9.909 | 9.762 | +0.147 | +0.85 | 0.396 |
| 9 | 9.772 | 9.972 | −0.200 | −1.15 | 0.251 |

- **The lucky-8 fingerprint is absent.** China ADRs end in 8 just **9.91%** of the time
  vs **9.76%** for the US controls — a +0.15 pp difference, *z* = +0.85, *p* = 0.40:
  indistinguishable. And 4 (the "death" digit) shows **no deficit** (+0.03 pp, *z* = 0.20).
- **The clustering that *is* there is round-number, not superstition.** Both baskets
  reject Uniform(1/10) — China χ²(9) = **289.6**, control **110.6** (crit 16.92) — but the
  rejection is driven almost entirely by the digit **0** (prices ending in .x0), the
  universal round-number preference (Harris 1991). China ADRs cluster on 0 *more* than the
  controls (12.29% vs 11.01%, *z* = **+6.86**) — a real China-specific clustering, but on
  the plain round number, **not** the lucky 8.
- *(χ² p-values are computed on serially-dependent pooled closes and so overstate
  significance — read the effect sizes and the China−control contrast, which cancels the
  common structure. The 8-vs-control contrast is null under any reading.)*

### Synthetic positive control B (clustering)

| world | digit-8 freq | *z*₈ | χ²(9) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| null (excess = 0), 20 seeds | ~10% | mean −0.30, \|z\| ≥ 2 in **0/20** | ~10 |
| planted +2 pp on digit 8 | 12.15% | **+14.32** | 384.8 |

A planted 8-excess lights the detector up; the uniform null never fires. The real-tape
null result is real, not a dead detector.

## Verdict

- **Signal — WEAK.** The lucky-day FXI−EEM abnormal return (+0.39%, *t* = +2.27, placebo
  *p* = 0.043) is a genuine nominal hit — the one honestly-surprising number on the tape —
  but it is the only one of two horizons to clear either bar, it is fragile (4/21
  leave-one-out drops, including the 08/08/08 triple-8 itself, sink it below *t* = 2), and
  the week horizon is noise (*t* = 0.69). Significant raw, fragile to horizon and
  selection: `WEAK`, not `REAL`.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** 8/8 is calendar-known, so the window *is* an executable
  trade — but at ~39 bps/yr gross the edge does not survive one round trip: net *t* =
  +1.69 (5 bps) / +1.10 (10 bps). No cut clears *t* ≥ 2 net.
- **8-clustering? — BUSTED.** On the US tape a China-ADR basket ends in 8 no more than a
  matched US-control basket (*z* = +0.85, *p* = 0.40) and shows no 4-deficit. Prices *do*
  cluster — on the round number 0, more so for China ADRs (*z* = +6.86) — but that is the
  universal round-number preference, not the lucky 8. The superstition's price fingerprint
  does not make it onto the US exchange tape.
